used_by_the_relay.name: Date
used_by_the_relay.description: The dimension that determines how date-based data in a chart is handled (the time dimension).

used_by_the_relay.name: Campaign ID
used_by_the_relay.description: The unique ID number of the ad campaign you're viewing in reporting. Your campaign contains ad sets and ads.

used_by_the_relay.name: Campaign
used_by_the_relay.description: The campaign name of the ad campaign you're viewing in reporting. Your campaign contains ad sets and ads.

used_by_the_relay.name: Amount Spent
used_by_the_relay.description: The estimated total amount of money you've spent on your campaign, ad set or ad during its schedule.

used_by_the_relay.name: Impressions
used_by_the_relay.description: The number of times your ads were on screen.

used_by_the_relay.name: Clicks
used_by_the_relay.description: The number of clicks on your ads.

used_by_the_relay.name: Account currency
used_by_the_relay.description: Currency that is used by your ad account. (duplicate)
